title: 子どもたちから学ぶもの

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, we're volunteering to play with some children at a nearby kindergarten.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Super Creek deftly chases the children around the playground, until…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She accidently hits her head full force on the playground equipment and sinks to the ground.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Sigh… That bump earlier really startled me.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'm fine. I was seeing stars right when I smacked my head…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: But after that, my mind actually felt surprisingly clear. I had a really easy time running for some reason.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hmm… Maybe… Maybe I can use this to my advantage in races?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hey, can we go back to the academy and test it out?
choice_data_list: You're going to hit your head again?!
You're going to hit your head again?!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! No, no! I just want to try running again.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: If all goes well, maybe I can make you smile even wider! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Super Creek appears to have figured something out by hitting her head, and her running noticeably improves!
